headline: Anvisa Seizes Unregistered Weight Loss Products And Durasteron
seoTitle: Anvisa Seizes Unregistered Weight Loss Products
metaDescription: Brazil's health regulator Anvisa has ordered the seizure of three unauthorized weight loss products and the drug Durasteron due to safety concerns.
aiSummaryBullets: Anvisa issued a resolution prohibiting the sale of three weight loss products and the drug Durasteron.
The seized items include TZ Gold, Retatrutide by Ayus Genetics, and GHK-CU, all lacking formal health registration.
Officials stated these products were manufactured by unidentified entities and contain compounds still in experimental testing phases.
aiContextParagraph: The Brazilian National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) has officially mandated the seizure and suspension of several medicinal products circulating without proper registration. The agency's resolution, published in the Federal Official Gazette, targets TZ Gold (containing tirzepatida), Retatrutide (produced by Ayus Genetics), and GHK-CU. Additionally, the regulator has acted against the drug Durasteron. According to regulatory officials, these substances are used for weight management and the treatment of type 2 diabetes but pose significant risks because they are produced by unidentified manufacturers. The agency emphasized that the compounds in question remain in laboratory research phases and have not undergone the necessary safety and efficacy evaluations required for legal distribution in Brazil. These measures are part of an ongoing effort by the agency to prevent the public from accessing unauthorized and potentially hazardous health products that claim to facilitate weight loss.
whyItIsViral: The development is considered viral due to consistent reporting across three independent news outlets, reflecting high public interest in health safety regulations.
